visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker with short dark hair, wearing a brown and white checkered shirt, stands in front of a warm indoor backdrop. Behind him is a vibrant red neon sign that reads 'TAIWAN BAR' and shelves stocked with various colorful beverage bottles in glass containers. The lighting is warm and bright, focusing on his expressive facial features as he speaks and uses open-handed gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a graphic overlay showing a membership table. The table lists 'Joining Duration' against 'Preview' with various black bear icons representing different badges. The background remains slightly visible but blurred. (3) The visual shifts to show two rectangular thumbnails side-by-side. The left thumbnail features 'TAIWAN BAR' with animated animal characters, and the right one titled 'Taiwan World History' shows a black bear figure. (4) The camera returns to the male speaker in the bar setting. He continues his energetic delivery, gesturing with both hands to emphasize his points. The neon sign glows steadily behind him. (5) Another graphic overlay appears, displaying two more animated series thumbnails: 'World History China' featuring multiple animals at a table, and 'Taiwan Cultural Memory' showing a stylized face. (6) The speaker is shown again at eye-level, maintaining direct engagement with the camera. He clasps his hands together briefly before opening them wide. (7) A dense grid of six different poster thumbnails appears on screen. Each poster represents a different series like 'Legal Bar', 'Economic Bar', and 'Philosophy Chicken Cake', featuring diverse cartoon styles and characters. (8) The final sequence shows the male speaker bowing respectfully and then waving. He wears a sincere expression. (9) The video concludes with a blurred view of the speaker in the background, while a sharp white text overlay with a drop shadow appears in the center, prompting viewers to leave a comment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2014 年開始. [Variety]: 《動畫臺灣史》. (2) [Subtitle]: 幸運的被許多觀眾注意到. (3) [Subtitle]: 觀看總數也超過了. [Variety]: 3,500 萬次. (4) [Subtitle]: 但說真的，這些動畫影片的製作成本. (5) [Subtitle]: 非常高，基本上是不可能靠. [Logo]: YouTube. (6) [Subtitle]: YouTube 平台的流量分潤收益平衡. (7) [Subtitle]: 因此我們希望有機會讓各位觀眾. (8) [Subtitle]: 一起成為臺灣吧製作計劃的一份子. (9) [Subtitle]: 具體來說，不同等級的頻道會員. (10) [Subtitle]: 分別享有哪些權益呢？ (11) [Subtitle]: 首先第一個等級是每月新臺幣 75 元的. [Slogan]: 灣吧好棒油. (12) [Slogan]: 超可愛的 會員徽章. [Subtitle]: 選擇這個方案的棒油可以獲得. (13) [Slogan]: 表情符號. [Logo]: TAIWAN BAR. (14) [Subtitle]: 並且享有《動畫臺灣史》. [Logo]: TAIWAN BAR. [Variety]: 《動畫臺灣史》 臺灣世界史. (15) [Subtitle]: 跟《臺灣世界史》全系列看到飽的權益. (16) [Subtitle]: 第二個等級是每月新臺幣 150 元. [Slogan]: 灣吧個人專屬吧台座. (17) [Subtitle]: 除了享有前面這個等級的所有福利以外. (18) [Subtitle]: 還會再多增加《動畫世界史中國篇》. [Variety]: 《動畫世界史中國篇》 《臺灣文化記憶》. (19) [Subtitle]: 跟《臺灣文化記憶》全系列看到飽權益. (20) [Subtitle]: 最後是第三個等級每月新臺幣 300 元的. [Slogan]: 灣吧豪華私人包廂. (21) [Subtitle]: 包含前兩個等級的所有福利再加上. (22) [Subtitle]: 《法律吧》《拼經濟吧》《哲學哲學雞蛋糕》. [Variety]: 《法律吧》 《拼經濟吧》 《哲學哲學雞蛋糕》 《學霸話經典》 《123募投人+木擊者》. (23) [Subtitle]: 《學霸話經典》《123募投人+木擊者》. (24) [Subtitle]: 這些過去經典的所有節目都可以完整的看到飽. (25) [Subtitle]: 再次感謝棒油們願意支持臺灣吧的創作. (26) [Subtitle]: 你的心意都能夠幫助我們. (27) [Subtitle]: 在未來繼續推出更好的作品. (28) [Slogan]: 留言 「會員」 瞭解更多資訊！

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a strategic promotion for the 'Taiwan Bar' YouTube membership program. It establishes a narrative of high production costs for their popular educational animations as a justification for seeking audience support, then systematically presents three membership tiers with increasing benefits to incentivize viewers to join.
